header.Bug #119344: Floating-point precision loss happen after changing UNION to UNION ALL

comments.author: cl hl
comments.text:
Description:
after changing UNION to UNION ALL,the col_1's float value 
lose precision

mysql> WITH cte_900 AS (SELECT yaa77.c4 AS col_1, SUBSTRING(yaa77.c3, 8, 7) AS col_2, LOG(yaa77.c4) AS col_3 FROM t1 AS yaa77 USE INDEX (idx_t1_c3_c5_c6)) (SELECT uaq26.col_1 AS col_1 FROM cte_900 AS uaq26) UNION SELECT DISTINCT glv67.c14 AS col_1 FROM t2 AS glv67 UNION SELECT tjb13.col_3 AS col_1 FROM cte_900 AS tjb13 WHERE tjb13.col_1 IS NULL;
+--------------------+
| col_1              |
+--------------------+
|                 90 |
|                 68 |
|                 36 |
|  90.91000366210938 |
|   71.5199966430664 |
| 24.290000915527344 |
|  76.33000183105469 |
|  8.760000228881836 |
|  97.70999908447266 |
+--------------------+
9 rows in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> WITH cte_900 AS (SELECT yaa77.c4 AS col_1, SUBSTRING(yaa77.c3, 8, 7) AS col_2, LOG(yaa77.c4) AS col_3 FROM t1 AS yaa77 USE INDEX (idx_t1_c3_c5_c6)) (SELECT uaq26.col_1 AS col_1 FROM cte_900 AS uaq26) UNION SELECT DISTINCT glv67.c14 AS col_1 FROM t2 AS glv67 UNION ALL SELECT tjb13.col_3 AS col_1 FROM cte_900 AS tjb13 WHERE tjb13.col_1 IS NULL;
+-------+
| col_1 |
+-------+
|    90 |
|    68 |
|    36 |
| 90.91 |
| 71.52 |
| 24.29 |
| 76.33 |
|  8.76 |
| 97.71 |
+-------+
9 rows in set (0.00 sec)

CREATE TABLE t1 (

    c3 VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    c4 INT NULL,
    c5 DATE NOT NULL,
    c6 VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (c1)
);

CREATE TABLE t2 (
    c1 INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    c2 INT NOT NULL,
    c3 DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    c4 VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    c5 DATE NOT NULL,
    c6 MEDIUMTEXT NULL,
    c7 LONGTEXT NULL,
    c8 MEDIUMBLOB NULL,
    c9 LONGBLOB NULL,
    c10 ENUM('value1','value2','value3') NULL,
    c11 SET('a','b','c','d') NULL,
    c12 BIT(8) NULL,
    c13 DATETIME NULL,
    c14 FLOAT(8,2) NULL,
    c15 DOUBLE(12,4) NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (c1)
);
